judge.label: LLM rubric score, fresh-context judge, self-assessed — not human QA.
judge.independence_caveat: This judge is a different model family and a fresh context: it saw only the judge prompt, the rubric and the lesson. It did not direct the project and did not author anything in it. It is still a language model scoring a language model's output, so the label applies: not human QA.

verdict_notes: All eight criteria at 4 or above; mean 4.25, floor 4 — comfortably inside the gate thresholds, though pass/fail is the gate's call. The knowledge checks are the strongest element: every distractor is a live misconception and the per-option feedback names it rather than restating the stem. The recurring theme in the 4s is small mismatches — takeaways summarising concepts L1 never defined, worked-example step 3 whose 'why' drifts from its 'show', and an Arabic rhythm that recurs across blocks — none of which reach the floor.
